news.title: Ellie Carpenter on a 'massive rivalry', revenge and a sea of blue
news.title_zh: 艾莉·卡彭特谈“大规模竞争”、复仇和蓝色海洋
news.body_en: Ellie Carpenter now has enough experience at Chelsea to know that our contests against Arsenal are always high stakes. In the WSL last season - Carpenter's first in blue - we drew at the Emirates Stadium before losing at home to our rivals. Then came a two-legged knockout clash in the Women’s Champions League quarter-final. With the atmosphere at fever pitch in both legs, the Gunners took a 3-1 lead into the decisive leg back in SW6, despite a closely-fought battle. The season before we had overturned a two-goal deficit against Manchester City at the Bridge in the UWCL quarter-final, securing a famous 3-0 victory. The whole stadium believed we could do the same again against Arsenal. A superb performance followed, but Sjoeke Nusken's late goal wasn't enough for us to advance. That’s where Carpenter picks up the story as we prepare to take on Arsenal at the Bridge once more, this time in the Women’s Super League. ‘It's a massive rivalry,’ she tells us. ‘Even before I joined the club, I remember I would always watch Arsenal against Chelsea. It's just one you'd want to put on TV. It’s always a good match, and always a high-tempo game with lots of things happening. It’s probably the biggest rivalry in the league. ‘None of us will ever forget that second leg against Arsenal, because of how well we played and also beating them as well. I guess we still want that bit of revenge for not going through to the semi-final of the Champions League. I'm sure that's in the back of our minds as well. ‘Arsenal are a great team, they have great players, and I'm sure they'll be up for the game. They’ve not been winning their recent matches in the league, so I'm sure they'll be hungry to get more points. It'll be a big game, so we'll have to turn up, and everyone will have to be at their best to win.’ Renee Slegers’ side have scored just twice in their opening three WSL games. After a 1-0 win over Brighton and Hove Albion, and a goalless draw with newly-promoted Crystal Palace, they needed a last-minute goal to grab a point against Manchester United. Yet as Carpenter explains, the team is unconcerned with any previous form, especially as the level of competition in the league is constantly increasing. ‘For us, we just need to focus on ourselves and play the football that we've been playing this season,’ she continued. ‘I think we've had really great performances in all three games. Now it's just about finishing off all the chances we're creating. We just need to keep playing our game plan. ‘Every game is big in the WSL. Right now is probably the strongest the league has ever been. Anyone can win on any given day. Anyone can take points from anyone, and that's what's so good about this league. ‘It's so competitive, and you have to be at your best every weekend to get the three points. That's why I think it's the best league in the world.’ Carpenter has been in top form so far this season. She earned the Player of the Match trophy against Birmingham City, and was also voted Star of the Match for her performance that day by our own supporters. Ahead of one of the biggest tests of the season, the Australian explained why she is revelling in the challenge of playing at the highest level for the Blues. ‘It’s why I wanted to move to England, for sure,’ she says. ‘To play for Chelsea is to play in the best league and to be tested every weekend. Not just against Arsenal, but every weekend it's a test, and you have to bring your best game to get the three points. ‘That’s what I'm enjoying about this league: the expectation and also the pressure to perform. It’s really helped me personally to grow as a footballer on the pitch. ‘I've had a good pre-season with the team, and I guess I'm in a more attacking role these first couple of matches, so it's been nice to get forward and probably more on the attack.’ We have declared the fixture against Arsenal a ‘Blue Day’, meaning there will be special events happening in and around the ground so that our supporters can show their allegiance in a very visual way on Sunday. Answer Ellie's call and get your tickets for Arsenal at the Bridge! Fans are being encouraged to wear Chelsea blue, bring their scarves and wave the flags that will be left on the seats. For those in the West Lower, there will be cards provided to make a mosaic as the teams walk out. And as the derby takes place during a break in men’s fixtures for internationals, it’s the ideal time for all Chelsea fans to show that London is blue. Ellie agrees. ‘It'll be good to see a sea of blue in the stands,’ she says. ‘Hopefully not many red shirts! It'll be nice to see Stamford Bridge full of blue, cheering for us, and hopefully we’ll get a great crowd.’ You can still attend today's huge London derby clash, with kick-off at the Bridge at 4.30pm!
news.body_zh: 艾莉·卡彭特现在在切尔西有足够的经验，知道我们对阵阿森纳的比赛总是高风险的。上赛季的 WSL 中——卡彭特首次身披蓝色球衣——我们在酋长球场战平，然后在主场输给了对手。随后，女足欧冠四分之一决赛进行了两回合淘汰赛。在SW6的决胜回合中，尽管双方战况胶着，枪手仍以3-1领先，两回合比赛气氛异常激烈。上个赛季，我们在 UWCL 四分之一决赛中逆转了曼城两球落后的局面，以 3-0 取得了著名的胜利。整个球场都相信我们可以在对阵阿森纳时再次做到同样的事情。接下来是一场精彩的表现，但 Sjoeke Nusken 最后的进球不足以让我们晋级。当我们准备再次在桥上迎战阿森纳时，卡彭特就从这里开始讲述这个故事，这次是在女子超级联赛中。 “这是一场巨大的竞争，”她告诉我们。 “即使在我加入俱乐部之前，我记得我总是会观看阿森纳对阵切尔西的比赛。这只是您想放在电视上的一个。这总是一场精彩的比赛，而且总是一场快节奏的比赛，会发生很多事情。这可能是联盟中最大的竞争。 “我们谁都不会忘记对阵阿森纳的第二回合，因为我们踢得很好，也击败了他们。我想我们仍然希望为未能进入欧冠半决赛而报仇。我确信这也在我们的脑海中。 “阿森纳是一支伟大的球队，他们拥有出色的球员，我相信他们会为比赛做好准备。他们最近在联赛中没有取得胜利，所以我相信他们会渴望获得更多积分。这将是一场重要的比赛，所以我们必须出场，每个人都必须发挥出最佳状态才能获胜。”蕾妮·斯莱格斯的球队在前三场 WSL 比赛中只进了两球。在1-0战胜布莱顿和霍夫阿尔比恩，并与升班马水晶宫互交白卷后，他们需要在最后时刻进球才能在对阵曼联的比赛中拿下一分。然而，正如卡彭特解释的那样，球队并不关心以前的任何形式，尤其是在联盟竞争水平不断提高的情况下。 “对我们来说，我们只需要专注于自己，踢出我们本赛季一直在踢的足球，”她继续说道。 “我认为我们在所有三场比赛中都有非常出色的表现。现在我们要做的就是消灭我们创造的所有机会。我们只需要继续执行我们的游戏计划即可。 “WSL 中的每场比赛都很重要。现在可能是联盟有史以来最强的。任何人都可以在任何一天获胜。任何人都可以从任何人那里拿分，这就是这个联盟的优点。 “竞争如此激烈，你必须每个周末都发挥出最佳状态才能获得三分。这就是为什么我认为这是世界上最好的联赛。”卡彭特本赛季到目前为止一直处于最佳状态。她在对阵伯明翰城的比赛中赢得了全场最佳球员奖杯，并因其当天的表现被我们自己的支持者评选为全场之星。在本赛季最大的考验之一之前，这位澳大利亚人解释了为什么她热衷于为蓝军打出最高水平的比赛的挑战。 “这当然是我想搬到英国的原因，”她说。 “为切尔西效力就是在最好的联赛中踢球，并且每个周末都要接受考验。不仅是对阵阿森纳，每个周末都是一场考验，你必须拿出最好的表现才能拿到三分。 “这就是我对这个联盟的享受：期望和表现的压力。这确实帮助我个人在球场上成长为一名足球运动员。 “我和球队一起度过了愉快的季前赛，我想在前几场比赛中我会扮演更具进攻性的角色，所以很高兴能够向前推进，并且可能会更多地进攻。”我们已经宣布对阵阿森纳的比赛为“蓝色日”，这意味着球场内和周围将会发生特别活动，以便我们的支持者可以在周日以非常直观的方式表达他们的忠诚。接听艾莉的电话，获取桥牌阿森纳队的门票！鼓励球迷穿切尔西蓝色衣服，带上围巾，并挥舞留在座位上的旗帜。对于西下层的人，当球队离开时，将会提供卡片来制作马赛克。由于德比战是在男子国际比赛间歇期举行，因此对于所有切尔西球迷来说，这是展示伦敦是蓝色的理想时机。 艾莉同意。 “很高兴能在看台上看到一片蓝色的海洋，”她说。 “希望不要有太多红衬衫！很高兴看到斯坦福桥充满蓝色，为我们加油，希望我们能吸引大批观众。”您仍然可以观看今天下午 4.30 在斯坦福桥举行的大型伦敦德比比赛！

news.title: From the archive: Peter Bonetti on the 1970 FA Cup final
news.title_zh: 档案摘录：Peter Bonetti 谈 1970 年足总杯决赛
news.body_en: On what would have been his 85th birthday, we look back to when the late, great Peter Bonetti shared his account of one of his greatest moments at Chelsea, our maiden FA Cup triumph in 1970. In the eyes of many, Bonetti - who sadly passed away in 2020 - is regarded as Chelsea's most legendary goalkeeper, and one of the greatest of his incredible 729 games for the Blues was reserved for the biggest of stages. In the FA Cup final of 1969/70, ‘the Cat’ was bright, brave and brilliant across two hours of high-octane, high-stakes football. He made some truly spectacular saves in the first game at Wembley and was our stand-out player as Dave Sexton’s side twice came from behind to force a replay. Up at Old Trafford a fortnight later, with a record TV audience of over 28 million watching at home, Bonetti’s efforts were superhuman as he battled through an early injury to defy Leeds United as our last line of defence. Although it was feline agility and reflexes that earned him his nickname, it was the heart of a lion in Manchester that saw him soldier on through another period of extra time, during which David Webb bundled in that famous winner to ensure the Blues were FA Cup victors for the very first time in our history. Those who watched at the time recall it as one of the most memorable goalkeeping performances in FA Cup final history, while the man who wore the gloves remembers it as the most physical game of his career. ‘They’re two of the most important games, as far as I’m concerned, in Chelsea’s history,’ Bonetti told us in 2010. ‘My memories of the FA Cup final are fantastic and obviously the games were quite exceptional too. ‘It was between two teams that didn’t really like one another and so it was obviously going to be a very physical battle between the two. I’d say that the replay at Old Trafford was the most physical game I ever played in. ‘I wasn’t necessarily referring to the Mick Jones incident where he banged into my knee because that sort of thing can happen – you go up and try to catch a ball and someone challenges you. His knee caught my knee and I don’t think it was deliberate. ‘So I didn’t just mean it was physical because of that, but both teams were so desperate to win because they didn’t like one another at the time. And I must say "at the time" because it’s a bit different today! ‘If the game had been refereed according to the rules and regulations of today, it wouldn’t have lasted! The tackling was wild, you had people kicking each other six foot in the air and trying to kick the ball as someone headed it! ‘But that was the way the game was played in those days, it was very physical. You were out to win, just like nowadays, but it was played in a more aggressive manner, I must admit.’ Bonetti felt it was the Chelsea character that proved the difference between two well-matched teams and speculated on what might have been had his own Herculean effort proved insufficient to keep him on the field after that first-half knee injury. A collision with Leeds centre-forward Jones had done the damage, leaving the Chelsea No1 struggling to even walk properly and requiring a pain-killing injection at half-time. At a time before substitute goalkeepers had been introduced to the game, there was a chance that the eventual match-winner could have had an altogether different role to play. ‘We showed great character over the two games,’ continued Bonetti. ‘I think we were behind three times and got back each time before Webby got the winner. It showed we had great character as a team and a tremendous blend of players. ‘We weren’t surprised when Webby got the goal. He was a great character who was fearless – he’d go up for set-pieces and just throw himself at everything. And he was a very recognised goal scorer too. He scored in the quarter-final and semi-final that year, and I remember him scoring three goals in a Boxing Day match at Ipswich once. He had the eye for a goal, no doubt about it. ‘If my knee injury had kept me out of the game then he’d have been the one to go in goal! If I got injured, he used to go in goal.’ The Cat was voted runner-up in the Footballer of the Year award at the end of that campaign, his FA Cup winners’ medal alongside others in the League Cup, European Cup Winners’ Cup and, of course, the FIFA World Cup. After hanging up his gloves in 1986, it was those medals that ultimately provided most pride to Bonetti. ‘It was the first time the club had ever won the FA Cup and the other thing was that it meant we won medals,' he concluded. ‘You always look back on your career at times when you have won something and there’s so many players who go through their careers without winning anything. So I regard myself as being lucky at having been able to win a couple of things.’ For the supporters who watched him at Stamford Bridge in his prime, it was certainly the Blues who were the lucky ones, for being able to count on Bonetti between the posts during an unbelievable Chelsea career spanning 20 years.
news.body_zh: 在他 85 岁生日之际，我们回顾了已故伟大的彼得·博内蒂分享的他在切尔西最伟大时刻之一的经历，即 1970 年我们首次夺得足总杯冠军。在很多人眼中，于 2020 年不幸去世的博内蒂被认为是切尔西最传奇的门将，他为蓝军效力的 729 场比赛中最伟大的一场被保留在最盛大的舞台上。在 1969/70 赛季的足总杯决赛中，“猫”在两个小时的高强度、高风险的足球比赛中表现得聪明、勇敢和出色。他在温布利的第一场比赛中做出了一些真正精彩的扑救，在戴夫·塞克斯顿的球队两次落后迫使重赛时，他是我们表现出色的球员。两周后，在老特拉福德，主场电视观众人数超过 2800 万，创历史新高。博内蒂在早期受伤的情况下奋力抗争，挑战了作为我们最后一道防线的利兹联队，他的努力是超人的。尽管猫科动物般的敏捷性和反应能力为他赢得了这个绰号，但正是曼彻斯特雄狮的心让他在又一个加时赛中奋勇前行，在此期间大卫·韦伯打进了那个著名的制胜球，确保了蓝军历史上第一次成为足总杯冠军。当时观看比赛的人回忆起这是足总杯决赛历史上最令人难忘的守门员表演之一，而戴上手套的人则认为这是他职业生涯中最激烈的比赛。 “就我而言，这是切尔西历史上最重要的两场比赛，”博内蒂在 2010 年告诉我们。“我对足总杯决赛的记忆非常美妙，显然那些比赛也非常特别。” “这是两支并不真正喜欢对方的球队之间的比赛，因此显然这将是两支球队之间的一场非常激烈的身体对抗。我想说，老特拉福德的重赛是我参加过的最激烈的比赛。“我不一定指的是米克·琼斯撞到我膝盖的事件，因为这种事情可能会发生——你站起来试图接球，有人挑战你。”他的膝盖撞到了我的膝盖，我不认为这是故意的。 “所以我的意思不仅仅是因为身体原因，而是两支球队都非常渴望获胜，因为他们当时不喜欢对方。我必须说“当时”，因为今天有点不同！ ‘如果比赛按照今天的规则进行裁判的话，比赛就不会持续下去了！抢断非常疯狂，人们在空中互相踢六英尺，并试图在有人头球时踢球！ “但这就是当时比赛的方式，非常需要身体对抗。你本来就是为了赢球，就像现在一样，但我必须承认，比赛的方式更具侵略性。”博内蒂认为，切尔西的性格证明了两支势均力敌的球队之间的差异，并推测，在上半场膝盖受伤后，如果他自己的巨大努力不足以让他留在场上，他可能会做出什么贡献。与利兹联中锋琼斯的碰撞造成了伤害，导致这位切尔西一号球员甚至难以正常行走，需要在半场休息时注射止痛药。在替补守门员被引入比赛之前，最终的获胜者有可能扮演完全不同的角色。 “我们在这两场比赛中表现出了出色的性格，”博内蒂继续说道。 “我认为我们曾三次落后，但每次都在韦比获胜之前扳回一城。这表明我们作为一个团队拥有伟大的性格和优秀的球员组合。 “当韦比进球时，我们并不感到惊讶。他是一个无所畏惧的伟大人物——他会拼尽全力去争取定位球。他也是一位非常受认可的射手。那年他在四分之一决赛和半决赛中都有进球，我记得有一次他在节礼日对阵伊普斯维奇的比赛中攻入三球。毫无疑问，他有目标的眼光。 “如果我的膝盖受伤让我缺席比赛，那么他就是那个进球的人！如果我受伤了，他就会进球。”在那场比赛结束时，猫被评为年度最佳足球先生亚军，他在联赛杯、欧洲优胜者杯，当然还有国际足联世界杯上与其他人一起获得了足总杯冠军奖牌。 1986 年挂起手套后，这些奖牌最终给博内蒂带来了最大的自豪。 “这是俱乐部第一次赢得足总杯冠军，另一件事是，这意味着我们赢得了奖牌，”他总结道。 “当你赢得一些东西时，你总是会回顾自己的职业生涯，而有很多球员在职业生涯中却什么也没赢得。因此，我认为自己很幸运，能够赢得一些东西。”对于那些在斯坦福桥观看他巅峰时期的球迷来说，蓝军无疑是幸运的，因为能够在长达 20 年的令人难以置信的切尔西职业生涯中依靠博内蒂在各个门柱之间发挥作用。

news.title: Make it a Blue Day this weekend when CFCW take on Arsenal!
news.title_zh: CFCW 迎战阿森纳，让这个周末成为蓝色日！
news.body_en: Stamford Bridge will host a blockbuster when Chelsea Women go up against the Gunners, and there are plenty of opportunities for Blues fans to play your part. The game between the two most successful clubs in the WSL era, the biggest London derby in women’s football, takes place at 4.30pm on Sunday, during the break for international fixtures for the men’s team. - Buy your tickets for the big match from just £20 by clicking here We are declaring it a Blue Day and to celebrate the occasion and show your support for the team, those at the Bridge can: Head to the Fan Zone at the Tea Bar for live music from Charlotte Campbell, free face painting, temporary CFCW tattoos, roaming family entertainment, poster making and more. Open from 2pm until 4:20pm, make sure to stop by and join the fun. Food and drink will also be available there. Pick up your Blue Day collectable patch to remember the afternoon by. If you are in the West Lower, join in making a mosaic by raising a card placed on your seat above your head as the teams walk out ahead of kick-off. Instructions will be outlined on the cards, and please do not swap cards with those around you. Look out for blue activities around the ground. Remember to bring your scarf and make sure to wave the flag on your seat to turn the Bridge into a sea of blue. Be in the stadium early for our full Blue Day-themed countdown to kick-off, featuring your favourite Blues anthems, our 'How blue are you?' crowd cam, and lots more to get the atmosphere rocking as we build up to the big match. Wear as much blue as possible. Our Megastore at the Bridge is a great place to make that happen. In the words of the famous Chelsea anthem, ‘We're gonna make this a Blue Day’, so please join in the fun and we’ll see you at the Bridge for the derby!
news.body_zh: 当切尔西女足对阵枪手时，斯坦福桥将迎来一场重磅赛事，蓝军球迷有很多机会发挥自己的作用。 WSL 时代两支最成功的俱乐部之间的比赛是女足规模最大的伦敦德比，将于周日下午 4 点 30 分在男队国际比赛间歇期间举行。 - 单击此处，仅需 20 英镑即可购买这场大型比赛的门票。我们宣布这一天为“蓝色日”，为了庆祝这一时刻并表达您对球队的支持，大桥的人们可以：前往 Tea Bar 的球迷区，欣赏 Charlotte Campbell 的现场音乐、免费脸部彩绘、临时 CFCW 纹身、漫游家庭娱乐、海报制作等。营业时间为下午 2 点至下午 4:20，请务必前往享受乐趣。那里也将提供食物和饮料。拿起您的 Blue Day 收藏补丁来纪念这个下午。如果您在西下区，当球队在开球前退场时，请将放置在您座位上的卡片举过头顶，加入制作马赛克的行列。卡片上会注明说明，请不要与周围的人交换卡片。留意地面周围的蓝色活动。记得带上围巾，并记得挥动座位上的旗帜，让大桥变成一片蓝色的海洋。尽早到达体育场，观看我们完整的蓝色日主题倒计时开始，其中包括您最喜欢的蓝调歌曲，以及我们的“你有多蓝？”观众摄像头，以及更多让我们为大赛做准备时气氛活跃的内容。尽可能多穿蓝色衣服。我们位于 Bridge 的大型商店是实现这一目标的好地方。用著名的切尔西队歌的话来说，“我们要让今天成为蓝色的一天”，所以请加入其中，我们在德比桥上见！

news.title: Internationals: Morgan Rogers features in England defeat
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：摩根·罗杰斯在英格兰失利中发挥重要作用
news.body_en: Blues forward Morgan Rogers was a second-half substitute as the Three Lions fell to a 3-2 defeat to world champions Spain at Wembley. It was an entertaining start to England’s Nations League campaign as Lamine Yamal opened the scoring within two minutes under the arch after pouncing on a defensive error, before the Three Lions hit back as Anthony Gordon and Harry Kane both struck to put the hosts into a 2-1 lead. After the break, Alex Baena levelled for the World Cup holders and, with 20 minutes left to play, Rogers was introduced by former Blues manager and current England boss Thomas Tuchel. Although Spain had the final say as Mikel Oyarzabal restored their lead soon after, Rogers looked bright, working angles from both flanks and delivering an impressive cross which was turned behind for a corner. Rogers could be in action once again on Tuesday when England head to Prague to take on Czechia in matchday two of the Nations League, with kick-off set for 7.45pm (UK time).
news.body_zh: 蓝军前锋摩根·罗杰斯下半场替补出场，帮助三狮军团在温布利以 3-2 输给世界冠军西班牙队。这是英格兰国家联赛的一个有趣的开局，拉明·亚马尔在防守失误后两分钟内就在拱门下首开纪录，随后三狮军团进行了反击，安东尼·戈登和哈里·凯恩双双进球，让东道主队以2-1领先。中场休息后，亚历克斯·巴埃纳为世界杯卫冕冠军扳平比分，比赛还剩20分钟时，前蓝军主帅、现任英格兰主帅托马斯·图切尔介绍罗杰斯上场。尽管西班牙队拥有最终决定权，米克尔·奥亚扎瓦尔很快就恢复了领先优势，但罗杰斯看起来很聪明，从两侧的角度工作并送出令人印象深刻的传中，后者被转入角球。周二，罗杰斯可能会再次上场，届时英格兰队将前往布拉格，在国家联赛第二轮比赛中迎战捷克队，开球时间为晚上 7 点 45 分（英国时间）。

news.title: Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season: Group B results
news.title_zh: 切尔西本赛季的终极目标：B 组结果
news.body_en: After the next round of voting for Chelsea's Ultimate Goal of the Season competition, the results are in. Ramires and Joao Pedro have secured their place in the quarter-finals... The vote, featuring five incredible strikes all from Brazilian's who have worn Blue over the years, was contested on the Chelsea Official App, and it was Ramires and JP who came out on top. The midfielder's chip is iconic in its own right, coming during that incredible Champions League semi-final at the Nou Camp, while Joao Pedro's bicycle kick is one of pure footballing beauty. The two winners beat off Goal of the Season winners from Juliano Belletti (2008), Oscar (2013) and Willian (2018). The hunt for Chelsea’s Ultimate Goal of the Season continues tomorrow (Sunday) as we open the polls for Group C, so you make sure you log back in to the Chelsea Official App to watch the contenders and cast your vote!
news.body_zh: 切尔西赛季终极进球的下一轮投票结束后，结果出炉了。拉米雷斯和若昂·佩德罗已经锁定了四分之一决赛的席位……此次投票共有五个令人难以置信的进球，全部来自多年来一直身着蓝色球衣的巴西球员，在切尔西官方应用程序上进行了角逐，最终拉米雷斯和 JP 脱颖而出。这位中场球员的进球本身就是标志性的，他在诺坎普球场那场令人难以置信的欧冠半决赛中表现出色，而若奥·佩德罗的自行车踢则是纯粹的足球之美之一。这两位获奖者击败了赛季最佳进球得主朱利亚诺·贝莱蒂（2008 年）、奥斯卡（2013 年）和威廉（2018 年）。明天（周日）我们将开启 C 组投票，争夺切尔西赛季最佳进球的活动将继续进行，因此请务必重新登录切尔西官方应用程序，观看竞争者并投票！

news.title: Chelsea Women trio talk rivalry with Arsenal ahead of Stamford Bridge derby
news.title_zh: 切尔西女足三人组在斯坦福桥德比之前谈论与阿森纳的竞争
news.body_en: As we look ahead to a huge London derby with Arsenal at Stamford Bridge on Sunday, we spoke with Blues Lucy Bronze, Lauren James and Sjoeke Nusken about what the rivalry means to them. The trio also discussed their standout moments against the Gunners, and one match in particular sprung to mind. Our 3-1 home victory against Arsenal in March 2024 came from a goal by James and a brace from Nusken. Our No.10 recalled that the kick-off was delayed by 30 minutes that day while the away side – who had forgotten their socks – had to source alternatives from our Megastore. Nusken remembers her unusual goal from that game, while Bronze looks back on a special celebration from Nusken and Mayra Ramirez at the Emirates in October 2024. To conclude, the three players reflect on what it would mean to put a marker down with a victory against our rivals at our new permanent home so early in the campaign. Here's what they had to say... Lucy Bronze: Yeah, it's a lot. Now that I play for Chelsea, I realise how big it is. I've played in a lot of derbies before; Merseyside, Manchester, both in France and Spain as well. I think because both teams are very successful, really top-level teams and fighting for the same things, it's probably one of the most heated rivalries I've played in terms of how close the competition is. Lauren James: It's a huge rivalry, but I played there as well, so I have a lot of respect for the club. It's two great teams going up against each other, so it's always going to be a tough game. I always want to do well, and you always want to do even better against the team you played for. Sjoeke Nusken: It's always a special game against them. It’s always the question: red or blue? You can feel the tension from everyone, every fan. Bronze: I remember when we played them at the Emirates in my first season, because Mayra and Sio did a celebration. There was the second leg of the Champions League last year too, and obviously we won the game, but we lost the tie. It was probably one of the most intense and aggressive performances that we have ever put on. We probably deserved a bit more from the game, but it was just such an intense game to be part of. James: For me, it was when we beat them at the Bridge, and they had to wear our socks. Seeing that moment sticks out the most. Nusken: The game when I scored with my bum, maybe! I actually scored twice, and we won this one at Stamford Bridge as well. Bronze: It’s nice to play a big, top team early in the season, especially as we get to play them at home as well. We perform well at home. It will give us a good gauge of where we are in terms of competing for the league. It’s an exciting game to be part of so early on. James: I don't think the season is decided by one game, especially so early on. But we definitely try to go into each game and show people what we're made of. Nusken: It’s always good to win against Arsenal. It's always a statement. I think especially after last season when we lost to them in the Champions League. This is the next game after that, so it will be a big game for us to win this one. Don't miss our huge London derby clash against Arsenal at Stamford Bridge! Secure your seat now...
news.body_zh: 当我们期待周日在斯坦福桥与阿森纳进行一场盛大的伦敦德比时，我们采访了蓝军露西·布朗兹、劳伦·詹姆斯和斯乔克·努斯肯，讨论了这场竞争对他们意味着什么。三人还讨论了他们对阵枪手的精彩时刻，其中一场比赛特别浮现在脑海中。 2024 年 3 月，我们在主场 3-1 战胜阿森纳，依靠的是詹姆斯的进球和努斯肯的梅开二度。我们的 10 号回忆起那天的开球推迟了 30 分钟，而客队忘记了袜子，不得不从我们的 Megastore 购买替代品。努斯肯还记得那场比赛中她不同寻常的进球，而青铜则回顾了 2024 年 10 月努斯肯和梅拉·拉米雷斯在酋长球场举行的特别庆祝活动。最后，三位球员思考了在赛季初期在我们的新永久主场战胜对手意味着什么。这是他们不得不说的... Lucy Bronze：是的，很多。现在我为切尔西效力，我意识到它有多大。我以前参加过很多德比战；默西塞德郡、曼彻斯特、法国和西班牙也是如此。我认为因为两支球队都非常成功，都是真正的顶级球队，并且为同样的事情而战，所以就竞争的激烈程度而言，这可能是我参加过的最激烈的竞争之一。劳伦·詹姆斯：这是一场巨大的竞争，但我也在那里踢球，所以我非常尊重俱乐部。这是两支伟大的球队相互对抗，所以这总是一场艰难的比赛。我总是想表现出色，而你总是想在对阵你所效力的球队时表现得更好。 Sjoeke Nusken：对阵他们总是一场特别的比赛。总是有一个问题：红色还是蓝色？你可以感受到每个人、每个粉丝的紧张。铜牌：我记得我第一个赛季在酋长球场对阵他们时，因为 Mayra 和 Sio 进行了庆祝。去年也有欧冠第二回合，显然我们赢了比赛，但我们输掉了平局。这可能是我们表演过的最激烈、最具侵略性的表演之一。我们可能应该从比赛中得到更多，但这是一场如此激烈的比赛。詹姆斯：对我来说，那是我们在蓝桥击败他们的时候，他们必须穿我们的袜子。看到那一刻是最引人注目的。 Nusken：也许是我用屁股进球的那场比赛吧！实际上我进了两个球，我们也在斯坦福桥赢得了这场比赛。铜牌：在赛季初与一支大型顶级球队比赛真是太好了，尤其是当我们也可以在主场与他们比赛时。我们在主场表现很好。它将使我们能够很好地衡量我们在联赛竞争中的位置。这么早就参与这是一场令人兴奋的比赛。詹姆斯：我不认为赛季是由一场比赛决定的，尤其是这么早。但我们绝对会尝试深入每场比赛并向人们展示我们的实力。努斯肯：战胜阿森纳总是好事。这始终是一个声明。我想尤其是在上赛季我们在冠军联赛中输给他们之后。这是之后的下一场比赛，所以对我们来说赢得这场比赛将是一场重要的比赛。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Melvine Malard talks 'the good life' at Chelsea in matchday programme
news.title_zh: 梅尔文·马拉德在比赛日节目中谈论切尔西的“美好生活”
news.body_en: There’s plenty for everyone in the matchday programme for Sunday’s blockbuster Women's Super League fixture between Chelsea Women and Arsenal at Stamford Bridge. We’ve got an interview with Melvine Malard, who has hit the ground running in Blue, as well as Hannah Hampton’s ‘Firsts & Favs’, a pull-out poster of Veerle Buurman and columns from Sonia Bompastor, Erin Cuthbert and Barbara Charone. In a programme exclusive, Malard says she can now think about 'the good life' as she reflects on a summer in which she made the move from Manchester to London, received a Ballon d’Or nomination and got married as well. She’s also looking forward after getting her first taste of life in a Blues shirt. 'In this team, we have a lot of players that can make so much difference with their quality, speed, vision, and dribbling,' she says. 'For the No9 like me, that’s an amazing thing when you play in this team.' She also discusses head coach Bompastor, with whom she goes way back, and admits she can’t wait to get out there for this massive derby game. 'I think it means a lot in London, it’s a big day in English football – two big teams, with big players, a lot of fans, in a big stadium. I can’t wait because when you play football, you want games like this coming, and I hope when this game comes, we will win!' In addition to all of that, we’ve also got your in-depth head-to-head game preview, all the opposition info and the latest facts and stats, not to mention plenty of puzzles and games to keep everyone occupied before the big kick-off and on the journey home. So be sure to get your copy from the programme sellers around the stadium!

news.title: Jordan Henderson: My Football Firsts
news.title_zh: 乔丹·亨德森：我的足球第一
news.body_en: Jordan Henderson takes on our quick-fire questions about his early days in football to help you get to know our summer signing a little better. What was the first football match you went to? My first game would have been at Roker Park, to see Sunderland. I can't remember the exact game, but that’s where it would have been, when I was very young. What were your first pair of football boots? I can’t remember what type, but they were probably Nike. What was the first football kit you owned? Probably the Sunderland kit, I definitely would have had a Sunderland shirt when I was very young. I think I can remember having a reversible Barcelona one as well, that was gold on one side. What was the first team you played for? You’re testing my memory! I’m older than everyone else, it was longer ago for me. I can’t remember, sorry. Who was your first room-mate on away trips? I played in the youth team with Martyn Waghorn. That was the youngest, I think, we were youth team age. Who was your first professional game against? In the Premier League it was against Chelsea at Stamford Bridge. I can remember it well because we lost 5-0! We were 3-0 down at half-time, and I came on, so it was not great. But it was a good Chelsea team we were playing against. I think my first-ever match for Sunderland was in a pre-season game against Ajax. Who was your first professional goal against? Professionally, I think it was for Coventry when I was on loan, against Norwich away in the Championship. What was your first emotion when you signed for Chelsea? It was a huge opportunity I couldn’t turn down. I was very excited to get going.
news.body_zh: 乔丹·亨德森回答了我们关于他早期足球生涯的快速问题，以帮助您更好地了解我们的夏季签约。你去看的第一场足球比赛是哪场？我的第一场比赛是在罗克公园球场，对阵桑德兰。我不记得具体的比赛了，但那是我很小的时候的比赛。您的第一双足球鞋是什么？我不记得是什么类型，但可能是耐克。您拥有的第一套足球装备是什么？可能是桑德兰的球衣，当我很小的时候，我肯定会拥有一件桑德兰的球衣。我想我还记得有一件双面巴塞罗那版，一侧是金色的。你效力的第一支球队是哪支球队？你这是在考验我的记忆力！我比其他人都老，对我来说那是很久以前的事情了。我不记得了，抱歉。谁是你外出旅行时的第一个室友？我和马丁·瓦霍恩一起在青年队踢球。我认为那是最年轻的，我们正值青年队年龄。你的第一场职业比赛是对阵谁？在英超联赛中，比赛是在斯坦福桥对阵切尔西。我记得很清楚，因为我们0-5输了！半场结束时我们0-3落后，我上场了，所以情况不太好。但我们面对的是一支优秀的切尔西队。我认为我代表桑德兰的第一场比赛是对阵阿贾克斯的季前赛。你的第一个职业进球是对阵谁？从职业角度来说，我认为我租借期间是在考文垂，在英冠联赛中客场对阵诺维奇。当你加盟切尔西时，你的第一感觉是什么？这是一个我无法拒绝的巨大机会。我很高兴能够出发。

news.title: Internationals: Goal and assist for Acheampong as Lavia makes winning return
news.title_zh: 国际比赛：拉维亚回归，阿奇姆蓬进球并助攻
news.body_en: Josh Acheampong scored his first goal for England at Under-21 level while Romeo Lavia and Maxence Lacroix opened their UEFA Nations League campaigns with victories. Lavia’s solitary previous international cap had come in March 2023, but his impressive start to the season with Chelsea saw him named in new Belgium manager Mark van Bommel’s first squad. His return to the pitch for his country came off the bench for the final 15 minutes, as he helped Belgium see out a professional but deserved 2-0 win away against Italy, to make a victorious start to the new Nations League campaign. Mark Penders was not involved for Belgium, while Honest Ahanor – who will join Chelsea next year – was an unused substitute for Italy. Lacroix featured at centre-back for the full 90 minutes as Zinedine Zidane made a winning start to life as France manager, beating Turkiye 1-0 in their own Nations League opener. They were made to work hard for their victory though, with chances for both teams before and after Kylian Mbappe’s solitary goal, until a late red card for Turkiye helped Les Blues and Lacroix to hold on to their clean sheet and the three points. Belgium and France will next face each other in the Nations League, in Brussels on Monday evening. Acheampong was named in England Under-21s’ starting line-up alongside fellow Blue Jamie Gittens, as they took on Kazakhstan in qualifying for next year’s UEFA European Under-21 Championship. In an end-to-end match the defender found the bottom corner with a sweet strike to put the Young Lions 2-1 up, having originally fallen behind, but the scores were levelled by half-time. Acheampong played a big part in England retaking the lead after the break, as his cushioned header was volleyed in by his centre-back partner Max Alleyne, before they scored again in added time to secure a 4-2 win. Another victory over Slovakia next Friday would officially book reigning champions England’s place at Euro 2027 with a game to spare. Geovany Quenda was in the Portugal Under-21s side which suffered a narrow defeat away at Bulgaria. He forced an excellent save from the home goalkeeper on three occasions before Portugal took the lead, but was withdrawn in the 88th minute, shortly after Bulgaria had equalised. That meant he was powerless to prevent his team conceding a decisive injury-time goal to lose 2-1. Defeat denied them qualification for the Under-21 Euros on the night, although a home win over Gibraltar on Wednesday would seal Portugal’s spot, regardless of other results. Elsewhere, Freddy Bernal and Chizaram Ezenwata both started for England Under-19s - as did Reggie Walsh, who is spending this season on loan with Wigan Athletic - in their narrow 1-0 friendly win over the Republic of Ireland at St George's Park.
news.body_zh: 乔什·阿奇姆蓬 (Josh Acheampong) 攻入了他在 21 岁以下国家队的首个进球，而罗密欧·拉维亚 (Romeo Lavia) 和马克森斯·拉克鲁瓦 (Maxence Lacroix) 则以胜利开启了他们的欧洲国家联赛之旅。拉维亚上一次代表国家队出场是在 2023 年 3 月，但他在切尔西的赛季开局令人印象深刻，因此入选了新任比利时主帅马克·范博梅尔的一线队。他在最后15分钟替补重返球场，帮助比利时客场2-0战胜意大利，取得了一场胜利，为新一届国家联赛开局。马克·彭德斯没有参加比利时队的比赛，而将于明年加盟切尔西的诚实·阿哈诺则在意大利队中没有上场。拉克鲁瓦在整场 90 分钟的比赛中担任中卫，齐达内在法国队的国联揭幕战中以 1-0 击败土耳其队，为法国队取得了胜利的开局。不过，他们必须为胜利而努力，在基利安·姆巴佩的唯一进球之前和之后，两支球队都有机会，直到图尔基耶最后一张红牌帮助蓝军和拉克鲁瓦保住了不失球和三分。比利时和法国接下来将于周一晚上在布鲁塞尔举行的国家联赛中交锋。 Acheampong 与蓝军队友杰米·吉滕斯一起入选英格兰 21 岁以下青年队的首发阵容，他们将与哈萨克斯坦队争夺明年欧洲 21 岁以下青年锦标赛的资格。在一场对决中，后卫攻入底角，一记漂亮的射门帮助原本落后的幼狮队2-1领先，但半场结束时比分被扳平。阿奇姆蓬在英格兰队中场休息后重新取得领先的过程中发挥了重要作用，他的头球被他的中后卫搭档马克斯·阿莱恩(Max Alleyne)凌空抽射，随后英格兰队在补时阶段再次进球，最终以4-2获胜。下周五如果再战胜斯洛伐克，卫冕冠军英格兰队将正式获得 2027 年欧洲杯的参赛资格，而且还剩一场比赛。乔瓦尼·昆达所在的葡萄牙21岁以下青年队在客场险胜保加利亚。在葡萄牙取得领先之前，他曾三次精彩扑救主队门将，但在保加利亚扳平比分后不久的第88分钟就被撤回。这意味着他无力阻止球队在伤停补时阶段丢掉决定性的进球，最终以 2-1 告负。尽管周三主场战胜直布罗陀，无论其他结果如何，葡萄牙队将锁定席位，但失败使他们失去了当晚参加 21 岁以下欧洲杯的资格。在其他地方，弗雷迪·伯纳尔和奇扎拉姆·埃森瓦塔都为英格兰 19 岁以下青年队首发——本赛季租借到维冈竞技的雷吉·沃尔什也是如此——在圣乔治公园以 1-0 险胜爱尔兰共和国的友谊赛中。

news.title: Key talking points from Sonia Bompastor's pre-Arsenal press conference
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯托在阿森纳赛前新闻发布会上的主要谈话要点
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor faced the media at Cobham ahead of our Women's Super League clash with Arsenal at Stamford Bridge, and here are the stand-out talking points from her press conference. We host the Gunners at Stamford Bridge on Sunday afternoon, and if you haven't got your ticket sorted already, you can still purchase yours here. The Blues have won all but one of our six matches so far this season, the anomaly a 1-1 draw with Aston Villa on the opening day of the Women's Super League campaign. Chelsea supporters are being asked to wear blue to make this London derby a 'Blue Day' in the stands and the whole team is looking forward to the clash, as Bompastor explained... 'It's two great teams going against each other. So when you are passionate about football, as a head coach and a player, you want to be involved in those games. 'We are really excited for the game on Sunday. We are playing at home, at Stamford Bridge. We are hoping for our fans to come and support us and hopefully we'll put on a strong performance to have a great afternoon.' 'I think it's important to have players who are able to beat their opponent, especially when you play against a team who are man-marking. 'Alyssa has the technicality and the speed to always beat her opponent one-v-one no matter the situation, whether she's facing forward or whether she's receiving the ball to feet and going beyond the back line. She's a player who loves to play with freedom because she has a lot of instinct and it's great to have a player like her. 'She can make a lot of difference on the pitch, so that's really important as well, especially when you play in big games.' 'I think fine margins will decide the game for sure and the details are really important. Both teams will have to be really strong in the defensive aspects not to concede, but also to create and be clinical to score the opportunities we make in the game. 'It's a massive fixture not only for the club and the players, but also for the fans. We want to play from the first minute until the end of the game and we will give our all to make sure we bring the fans along with us. The best way is to score and to embrace the game. So we'll try to do that.' 'I think that was the first time in the season where we faced a team with a direct style of football. The only thing they wanted to do is to play long balls behind the back line, then fight for the first and the second ball. 'So it was good for us to be in that position. And even against a team who played direct, I don't think we conceded many opportunities. I think we were strong in the duels and also we dealt well with the transitions. 'But also we faced a team who were man-marking everywhere on the pitch. We spoke a lot about finding solutions when you play a team who are doing that in terms of the spaces and the different movements you need to create the space. 'It was really positive to be going into these next two games having faced a team who were causing us some challenges. So it's good to approach Sunday's game having had this one in the bag.' 'I think for me, the most important thing – as I told my players – it's not always about the system, but instead it's about the way we animate the system. 'But we don't change our main principles and our philosophy no matter what system we are playing. So for me, I have players smart enough to know and to recognise the positions they need to play and what they need to do in every position they are playing in, and they are adaptable with that, so it's good.' news.body_zh: 在斯坦福桥与阿森纳的女足超级联赛比赛之前，索尼娅·邦帕斯托在科巴姆接受了媒体采访，以下是她在新闻发布会上的重要谈话要点。周日下午我们将在斯坦福桥迎战枪手队，如果您还没有找到门票，您仍然可以在这里购买门票。本赛季到目前为止，蓝军在六场比赛中只赢了一场，其中异常的是在女足超级联赛揭幕战中1-1战平阿斯顿维拉。切尔西的支持者被要求穿蓝色衣服，让这场伦敦德比成为看台上的“蓝色日”，全队都期待着这场冲突，正如邦帕斯特解释的那样……“这是两支伟大的球队相互对抗。”因此，当你对足球充满热情时，作为主教练和球员，你会想参与到这些比赛中。 “我们对周日的比赛感到非常兴奋。我们在斯坦福桥的主场比赛。我们希望我们的球迷能够来支持我们，希望我们能拿出出色的表现，度过一个美好的下午。” “我认为拥有能够击败对手的球员很重要，尤其是当你对阵一支盯人的球队时。 “阿莉莎拥有技术性和速度，无论在什么情况下，无论她是面朝前方，还是脚接球并越过后线，她总是能在一对一的情况下击败对手。她是一位喜欢自由发挥的球员，因为她有很多本能，拥有像她这样的球员真是太好了。 “她可以在球场上发挥很大的作用，所以这也非常重要，尤其是当你参加大型比赛时。” “我认为良好的利润肯定会决定比赛的结果，细节非常重要。两支球队都必须在防守方面非常强大，才能不失球，同时还要创造并冷静地抓住我们在比赛中创造的机会。 “这不仅对俱乐部和球员来说是一场盛大的比赛，对球迷来说也是如此。我们希望从第一分钟一直打到比赛结束，我们将竭尽全力确保球迷与我们同在。最好的方法是得分并拥抱比赛。所以我们会尝试这样做。 “我认为这是本赛季我们第一次面对一支具有直接足球风格的球队。他们唯一想做的就是在后卫线后面打长传，然后争夺第一球和第二球。 “所以我们处于这个位置对我们来说是件好事。即使对阵直接打球的球队，我认为我们也没有丢掉很多机会。我认为我们在决斗中表现强劲，而且我们也很好地处理了过渡。 “但我们也面临着一支在球场上到处盯人的球队。我们谈论了很多关于当你与一支正在做空间和创造空间所需的不同动作方面这样做的团队时寻找解决方案的问题。 “在接下来的两场比赛中面对一支给我们带来一些挑战的球队真的很积极。因此，带着这个包进入周日的比赛是件好事。” “我认为对我来说，最重要的事情 - 正如我告诉我的球员 - 它并不总是与系统有关，而是与我们为系统提供动画的方式有关。 “但无论我们采用什么体系，我们都不会改变我们的主要原则和理念。所以对我来说，我的球员足够聪明，能够了解并认识到他们需要踢的位置以及他们在每个位置上需要做什么，并且他们能够适应这一点，所以这很好。不要错过我们在斯坦福桥对阵阿森纳的伦敦德比大战！赶紧抢座位吧……

news.title: Sonia Bompastor gives fitness updates on Lauren James and Keira Walsh
news.title_zh: 索尼娅·邦帕斯特 (Sonia Bompastor) 分享劳伦·詹姆斯 (Lauren James) 和凯拉·沃尔什 (Keira Walsh) 的最新健身状况
news.body_en: Sonia Bompastor delivered a team news update on a key Chelsea quartet ahead of our London derby with Arsenal on Sunday afternoon. The Blues face a big test this weekend as we go up against rivals Arsenal, and Bompastor gave the latest on who she will have available to face the Gunners. There remains a doubt over whether two of our key players will be fit to start at Stamford Bridge on Sunday. Lauren James missed Wednesday evening's win over Austria Vienna with what the head coach described as a small knock, while Keira Walsh started in midweek but was substituted 20 minutes in, after feeling some pain in her calf. 'It's probably one of the first times I'm not in a position to share a lot with you,' explained Bompastor. 'Because we played two days ago, and we still have a training session tomorrow. 'I need to meet with my performance staff to assess all the players and I'll probably have more information tomorrow before the game.' There was some good news about another key duo from the Friday afternoon press conference. After a pre-planned substitution at half-time against Austria Vienna, Melvine Malard came through unscathed and will be available for selection on Sunday. Our head coach explained some of the striker's key attributes. 'Melvine was training this morning, so she's in a good place,' Bompastor continued. 'She's in contention for the game on Sunday. It was the plan for her to play 45 minutes. She's still building from pre-season. 'I think she's a player who is really confident now. She's the No9 for the French national team, but she also came into our environment with a lot of confidence from last season and the good season she had with Man United. 'She's really technical and has a lot of speed in the attacking line, so she's a threat for any team, and I think it's good to have her in our squad. So hopefully she'll have a good game on Sunday if she's starting or coming on.' Naomi Girma is also returning to fitness and was an unused substitute in Wednesday night's Women's Champions League win. Bompastor explained where the defender is up to in terms of her availability. 'Nay is training fully right now with the squad,' said the head coach. 'I think in the game on Wednesday, it was not always easy to bring defenders on, especially in the last 10 minutes where the balls were coming and they were playing direct football. 'But she's doing good. She's training fully. I think probably what we need to get from Nay is being consistently on the pitch, but we are all around her trying to support her to be able to achieve that. 'It's great to have a player with her mentality. She's a hard worker and she brings a lot of quality. So if she's able to get minutes again and stay consistently on the pitch, it will be great news.' news.body_en: Estevao Willian made his return to Brazil’s starting line-up and was close to marking it by netting a decisive goal, but had to settle for a draw after his strike was ruled out. The Chelsea winger was recalled by the Selecao for this international window, which they begin with back-to-back friendlies away against Australia. Joao Pedro had also been named in their squad, but was later withdrawn. Estevao went straight into Carlo Ancelotti’s line-up for the first of those friendlies down under, making his first start for his country since scoring in a 1-1 draw with Tunisia last November. It was nearly a similar story in this match, when Estevao thought he had given his team the lead in first-half stoppage time by firing into the bottom-left corner. However, VAR intervened and disallowed the goal for a foul by Bruno Guimaraes in the build-up. Instead it was the hosts Australia who took the lead through a Nestory Irankunda free-kick after the break, despite Brazil having the better of the possession. Estevao was withdrawn with 15 minutes remaining, but Brazil managed to salvage a draw with virtually the last kick of the game, when Rayan headed in a Raphinha corner in the fifth minute of added time. After that 1-1 draw, Brazil and Australia will meet again in Sydney on Tuesday, with kick-off at 11am UK time.
news.body_zh: 埃斯特沃·威廉重返巴西首发阵容，差点打入决定性进球，但在他的进球被判无效后，只能以平局收场。这位切尔西边锋被桑巴军团召回参加本次国际比赛，他们从客场对阵澳大利亚的背靠背友谊赛开始。若昂·佩德罗也曾入选他们的阵容，但后来被撤回。埃斯特沃直接进入了安切洛蒂的首发阵容，参加了澳大利亚的第一场友谊赛，这是他自去年11月1-1战平突尼斯队进球后首次代表国家队首发。这场比赛的情况也几乎类似，埃斯特沃认为自己在上半场补时阶段射入左下角，帮助球队取得了领先。然而，VAR介入并判定布鲁诺·吉马良斯在进攻中犯规，进球无效。相反，东道主澳大利亚队在中场休息后通过内斯托里·伊兰昆达的任意球取得领先，尽管巴西队拥有更好的控球权。埃斯特瓦奥在比赛还剩 15 分钟时被撤下，但巴西队在补时第 5 分钟拉扬接到拉芬哈角球时头球破门，几乎是在比赛的最后一脚挽救了平局。 1-1 战平后，巴西队和澳大利亚队将于周二在悉尼再次相遇，比赛时间为英国时间上午 11 点。
